svg.title: Two slices through an arrangement glued from two codes
svg.desc: Two globes, each a three-dimensional slice through one block. Grey caps are axial points. Left: the four caps of a block of code C with first coordinate +1 are present and the four with first coordinate -1 are empty sites. Right: the reverse, for a block of code C prime.
